CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CREDITRISK_CRM
AS
BEGIN
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk AS(
	SELECT
		BCC.VALUE AS CreditRiskId
		,BCC.DESCRIPTION AS CreditRiskName
		,NULL AS CreditRiskDescription
		,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
		,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC 
	ON BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	WHERE BCC.CATEGORYTYPE = 'CBC_RATING'
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk FROM TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_SRC AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CreditRiskId, CreditRiskName, FinancialInstitutionId, CategoryId)) AS HASHROW
		,CreditRiskId
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_TGT AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CreditRiskId, CreditRiskName, FinancialInstitutionId, CategoryId)) AS HASHROW
		,CreditRiskId
    FROM BNKM.CreditRisk
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_DELTA AS (
	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CreditRiskId,TGT.CreditRiskId) AS CreditRiskId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CREDITRISK_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CREDITRISK_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.CreditRiskId = TGT.CreditRiskId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[CreditRiskId] = SRC.CreditRiskId
	,[CreditRiskName] = SRC.CreditRiskName
	,[CreditRiskDescription] = NULL
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[CategoryId] = SRC.CategoryId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CRM'
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = getdate()
FROM BNKM.CreditRisk TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CreditRiskId = TGT.CreditRiskId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk SRC ON SRC.CreditRiskId = TGT.CreditRiskId;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CreditRisk (
	[CreditRiskId]
	,[CreditRiskName]
	,[CreditRiskDescription]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[CategoryId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CreditRiskId]
	,[CreditRiskName]
	,[CreditRiskDescription]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[CategoryId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CreditRisk_DELTA;

END
